Space Invaders is complete and verified. Here's what was done this session:

## Implementation
All 16 `Space_Invaders/` files are in place and mutually consistent:
- **config.js** — single source of truth (species, wave curves, formation grid, palette)
- **entities/** — Player, Invader (shared species geometry), PlayerBullet, InvaderBullet, UFO, Shield (InstancedMesh bunkers)
- **systems/** — Formation (march/drop/edge-turn), Spawner (stochastic fire + UFO), Collision (hand-written AABB), Scoring (combo + localStorage high score), WaveManager (scaling curves)
- **vfx/** — VFXDirector (event→VFX recipes), Starfield (procedural points + nebula)
- **main.js** — composition root wiring Engine, PostFX (bloom), all VFX, HUD, state machine, and full `dispose()`
- **index.html** — game entry

Plus the root **hub `index.html`** (glassmorphism arcade landing page) and a reconciled **`vite.config.js`** (only entries that exist on disk).

## Bugs found & fixed
- **Spawner** duplicated wave-scaling curves → now routes through WaveManager (single source of truth)
- **Player** missing `invulnerable` getter that Collision reads → added
- **Engine** `onResize` captured at construction → mutable hook holder
- **Bullet pools** had no reset → re-acquired bullets lingered at old position for a frame → added `kill()`/`deactivate()` on acquire
- **Bullet trail** drew a connecting line when the tracked bullet changed → reset on target switch
- **Double `shake.update`** per frame (once in VFXDirector, once in main) → trauma decayed at 2× speed → removed the duplicate

## Verified (not just built)
- `npm run build` — 48 modules, both entries emitted, no errors
- **Headless Chromium smoke test** (real page load, SwiftShader WebGL): boots, renders, HUD mounts, Start works, score advances to 30 (one squid kill), **zero console/page errors**
- **Extended test**: 30s of continuous play, lives stay in [0,3], `dispose()` runs clean and removes the HUD
- **Invader-fire test**: player held stationary → lives dropped 3→1, game-over triggered, no page errors

All core gameplay paths (player fire→kill→score, invader fire→player hit→lives→game over, VFX, audio, teardown) are confirmed working in a real browser.
